title: Frosted widescreen captions
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for planning, wrapping, rendering and checking burned-in widescreen film captions in a 156 px lower band (y 924-1080) with a frosted pill centered at (960, 1002), clause-then-balance line breaks, small-gap cue bridging and reading-time checks.
boundaries: Caption pills stay inside the 156 px lower band (y 924-1080) centered at (960, 1002) with at least 24 px edge clearance and never intrude into the stage (y 4-924).
Web players keep native caption tracks in hidden or disabled mode rather than drawing a second browser box over burned-in pills.
Admitting a film caption check receipt requires an independent distinct_reviewer.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for planning, wrapping, rendering and checking burned-in widescreen film captions in a 156 px lower band (y 924-1080) with a frosted pill centered at (960, 1002), clause-then-balance line breaks, small-gap cue bridging and reading-time checks

value.lets_workers: Split narration lines into two-line 42-character caption cues at clause boundaries, bridge gaps up to 0.5 s so the frosted pill never blinks, render deterministic 1920x156 SVG caption bands centered at (960, 1002), and check reading-time budgets (0.5 + words/3.0 s).

flow.when: Split narration lines into clause-balanced cues of at most 2 lines and 42 characters per line with bridged visibility spans.
Render deterministic 1920x156 SVG caption band frames with the frosted pill centered at (960, 1002).
Independently check a cut's caption cues against film-frame v6 line, CPS, clearance and reading-time rules.

value.worked_example: Made-up narration cues recomputed in test_captions.py: clause-then-balance wrapping protects model names and avoids trailing articles/prepositions, 0.3 s gaps bridge cleanly without blinking, two-line pills hold 108 px height centered at y=1002 with 24 px band clearance, and deterministic SVG output escapes XML entities.

nouns.title: Guardrail: never render a native browser caption box over burned-in frosted caption pills
nouns.category_reason: Prevents double-caption visual collisions in widescreen film playback.

value.rule: Films use the burned-in frosted pill inside y 924-1080 while the web video player keeps textTrack.mode in hidden or disabled, never showing.
value.how_it_is_checked: frame_v6.json specifies web_player track modes and geometry.py verifies inside_band clearance.

nouns.title: Guardrail: caption timing and geometry gate receipts require an independent reviewer
nouns.category_reason: Separates cue generation from final film-frame v6 timing and clearance sign-off.

value.rule: The worker verifying caption line bounds, reading-speed holds and band clearance cannot share worker_id or key_id with the cue planner.

nouns.title: Specification: film-frame v6 156 px lower band, (960, 1002) frosted pill geometry and timing bounds
nouns.category_reason: Canonical widescreen frame and caption-pill dimensions shared by renderers and checkers.

nouns.title: Clause-then-balance two-line caption wrapping and cue-bridging procedure
nouns.category_reason: Deterministic zero-model scoring for readable two-line breaks and blink-free cue spans.

nouns.category_reason: Tested Python 3.10+ standard-library package pinned by path, file count and SHA-256.

value.name: frosted captions
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
does: Wraps and splits narration cues into balanced 2x42 lines without splitting protected model names or stranding articles.
Computes lead, linger and 0.5 s bridged visibility spans and checks reading budgets (0.5 + words/3.0 s).
Computes pill bounding boxes centered at (960, 1002) and renders deterministic 1920x156 SVG bands.
does_not: Mutate video files directly, rely on external font engines or invoke models.

value.describes: a deterministic verification receipt for caption line limits, reading-time spans and pill band clearance

nouns.title: Worked example: made-up two-line caption cues checked for v6 band clearance, bridging and SVG determinism

value.shows: Two-line pill height 108 px centers at (960, 1002) with 24 px band clearance, clears the (48, 932, 120, 140) guide zone and passes reading-speed checks.
value.source: Made-up example cues checked in packs/frosted-widescreen-captions/code.

verbs.title: Cut narration into caption cues and wrap lines at clause boundaries
verbs.summary: Split narration lines into two-line 42-character caption cues using clause-then-balance scoring and compute bridged visibility spans.
verbs.outcome: Wrapped caption cue plan with bridged visibility spans.

slots.name: narration_lines
slots.description: Pin of timed narration lines to split and wrap into caption cues.

steps: Split overlong narration lines at clause boundaries with split_cues() and wrap each cue with wrap_balanced().
Compute lead, linger and 0.5 s gap-bridged visibility spans via visible_spans().

acceptance.check: Every cue fits at most 2 lines of 42 characters and remains visible for at least 0.5 + words/3.0 seconds.

verbs.title: Render deterministic 1920x156 SVG caption band frames with centered frosted pills
verbs.summary: Render escaped, deterministic SVG frames for the 156 px lower band with the frosted pill centered at (960, 1002).

slots.name: cue_plan
slots.description: Pin of the wrapped caption cue plan.

steps: Compute pill_box(lines) centered at (960, 1002) and verify 24 px clearance inside y 924-1080.
Render deterministic escaped SVG markup via band_svg().

acceptance.check: Pill center is within 2 px of (960, 1002), inside_band(box) is true and XML special characters are escaped.

verbs.title: Check a cut's caption cues against film-frame v6 timing and geometry rules
verbs.summary: Verify with a distinct reviewer that a cut's caption cues produce zero errors from check(), keep 24 px band clearance and pass AST magic-literal checks.
verbs.outcome: Independent film-frame v6 caption verification receipt.

slots.name: candidate_cues
slots.description: Pin of the candidate caption cue list and film duration.

steps: Run check(cues, film_end) and inside_band() across every cue in the cut.
Confirm zero error-severity findings and distinct reviewer identity.

acceptance.check: error_count from check() is 0, inside_band is true and ast_violation_count is 0.
